# Pull request

Thank you for contributing. Please make sure the checklist below is complete
before requesting a review.

## What does this change?

Describe the change and the problem it solves. Link the related issue if any.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Internal / refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] `cargo check` passes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated if the change is user-visible

## Related issue

Closes #
